answer: Harbor Conference Hall has 312 square meters of space. Its largest listed capacity is 240 guests in a theater layout. The audiovisual equipment includes a ceiling-mounted projector, a motorized projection screen, and a wireless microphone system. Available event services are an on-site meeting coordinator and coffee-break catering.

raw_webpage_html:
Alder Quay Business Hotel

Harbor Conference Hall

Harbor Conference Hall offers 312 square meters of meeting space. Available layouts are theater for up to 240 guests, classroom for up to 144 guests, and U-shaped for up to 54 guests.

Built-in audiovisual equipment includes a ceiling-mounted projector, a motorized projection screen, and a wireless microphone system. Event services include an on-site meeting coordinator and coffee-break catering.
